details: Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT): adopted 1968; entered force 1970; 191 states party (3 non-party: India; Pakistan; South Sudan; Israel never confirms/denies); FOUR pillars: (1) Non-proliferation: NWS (nuclear weapon states: US; Russia; UK; France; China) agree not to transfer nuclear weapons/materials; NNWS agree not to acquire; (2) Disarmament: NWS commit to pursue disarmament (Article VI; contested as unfulfilled); (3) Peaceful use: NNWS have right to peaceful nuclear programs (Article IV); (4) Safeguards: IAEA verifies non-diversion of nuclear material from peaceful to weapons use; USSR was founding NWS; Soviet nuclear program: exempt from safeguards (NWS); RBMK reactors NOT under IAEA safeguards (Soviet military origin of graphite reactor design; NWS exemption); Ukrainian nuclear arsenal (when independent 1991): inherited ~1,900 strategic warheads; gave up under Budapest Memorandum 1994
